title: The Secret of the Hidden Key

scenes.text: Sam and Jake discover a hidden treasure map inside a book.
scenes.image_prompt: two boys finding map inside old library book

scenes.text: They follow the map to find a hidden key near a tree.
scenes.image_prompt: boys digging near tree roots and finding key

scenes.text: They enter an abandoned mill and discover a hidden passage.
scenes.image_prompt: old mill with trapdoor leading underground

scenes.text: They find a chest but must escape as traps activate.
scenes.image_prompt: boys running from closing stone doors underground

scenes.summary: They escape and learn a lesson.
scenes.text: They safely open the treasure and read a message about courage.
scenes.image_prompt: boys opening chest in treehouse smiling

story: Sam and Jake find a treasure map and follow it through a tree, a mill, and underground tunnels. They face danger but escape safely and discover a treasure that teaches them about courage and adventure.
